prompt:
In the early 1900s, chemist Alice Ball developed a method for preparing chaulmoogra oil so it could be injected and more easily absorbed by the body. At the time, the oil was one of the few treatments used for Hansen’s disease, but earlier forms of it were difficult for patients to take. Ball’s work therefore made an existing treatment more ______.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
explanation: Ball’s method made a difficult treatment easier to use and absorb, so “practical” is the most precise choice.

prompt:
A rain garden is a shallow planted area designed to collect rainwater from roofs, driveways, or sidewalks. As the water slowly soaks into the soil, plants and soil can filter out some pollutants. Rain gardens can also reduce the amount of stormwater flowing into nearby streets and drains.
Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

choices.A: Rain gardens can help manage stormwater and filter some pollutants.
choices.B: Rain gardens are designed mainly to replace all other types of gardens.
choices.C: Stormwater drains prevent rainwater from reaching streets.
choices.D: Plants in rain gardens cannot grow unless the soil stays completely dry.

explanation: The passage explains that rain gardens collect runoff, filter some pollutants, and reduce water flowing into drains.

prompt:

prompt:

choices.B: Leo decides that pottery is too simple to practice.
choices.C: Leo teaches his instructor how to shape a bowl.
choices.D: Leo breaks the pottery wheel before he can use it.

prompt:

prompt:

• Although it has striped legs like a zebra, it is more closely related to the giraffe.

• Their dark coats help them blend into shaded forest areas.
• Conservation groups work to protect okapi habitat.

choices.A: The okapi lives in forests in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
choices.B: Although the okapi has striped legs like a zebra, it is more closely related to the giraffe.
choices.C: Okapis use long tongues to pull leaves from branches in forest habitats.
choices.D: Conservation groups work to protect the places where okapis live.

explanation: This choice emphasizes the surprising fact that the okapi looks somewhat zebra-like but is related to the giraffe.

prompt:
